preModelEnvironmentFailure.evidence: Mechanically proven from the frozen per-task records of run 36711152110, independently re-read from docs/benchmarks/history/frontier-harness/20260930T115155Z--36711152110.json (sha256 6beaf87fa081441d293ef58a78dce29c36c3307de93a0292e2b697f289ed6ba9): each cell's exception is RuntimeError 'Docker compose command failed for environment <task>', whose captured build output ends at '#3 ERROR: failed to copy: httpReadSeeker: failed open: unexpected status code https://public.ecr.aws/v2/d3j8x8q7/swe-bench-202605/manifests/sha256:<digest>: 429 Too Many Requests - Server message: toomanyrequests: Data limit exceeded'. All three strings ('429 Too Many Requests', 'toomanyrequests', 'Data limit exceeded') occur exactly three times each in the record, once per cell. The trial never reached the agent phase: the three durations are 5549ms / 6065ms / 5558ms, each per-task record carries no artifacts at all (no jobs/<task>/.../agent/best-agent-evidence.jsonl, no process receipt, no attempt timing), and the aggregate classifies them as disposition=error with no rewards. There is therefore no model request, no attempt and no prediction to overwrite. This is the class AGENTS.md admits for benchmark-level recovery, and it is the same signature the 2026-09-27 precedent admitted (recovery-no-prediction-20260927 filled three beta.37 ECR cells 3/3).

notAdmitted.why: Both cells carry a real graded prediction (disposition=failed, reward=0, a full attempt evidence file with 58 and 30 model outcomes) and their primary Run was cancelled by beta.41's own attempt-delivery budget boundary at ~719.9s of a 900s attempt budget (ATTEMPT_DELIVERY_RESERVE_MS = 180000), not by an environment or upstream event; the one in-flight call was cut by that cancellation and recorded as model-failure reason=transport. They are excluded here: no prediction may be replaced, and the class is not a pre-model environment failure nor an explicit provider transport failure.

fairnessInvariant: Across the whole reading, every one of the 30 cells carries exactly ONE graded model attempt: the 27 already-valid cells keep the attempt they had in run 36711152110, and each refilled cell received its single graded attempt from the recovery chain because its source-run cell had none at all (no model request, no agent directory, no evidence file). No cell was attempted twice with a verdict to choose from, no verdict was replaced or reinterpreted, no evaluator output re-entered a model attempt, and no budget, effort or grader setting was changed.
